hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: Macro
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: LY_COMMON 联运默认版本 LY_ZX 坠星大陆 LY_SELF QuickSDK官网自发版本 USE_CUSTOM_ACCOUNT 白包

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: IsBuildPkg
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: //构建安装包或者导出xcode或者webgl工程

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: PkgType
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: AllRes 安装包包含所有资源 NoRes安装包包含不包含资源 HalfRes安装包包含包含部分资源

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: OnlyBuildProject
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: 只编译工程，不重新导出

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: AbdetailVer
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: 1_1.0.0.1 坠星大陆 40_lyqq_1.0.0.0 md5为crc 28_ly100_1.0.0.1 bundle hash为crc 基础资源清单存放目录

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: ABNameWithHash
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: 生成的补丁，ab资源名称是否需要待遇hash值，目前只有webgl需要勾选

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: OutputPath
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: 导出路径（app工程导出路径）空值有代码指定

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: AssetLoadType
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: WEBGL首包资源存放在CDN：0, 本地：1

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET SVN_USERNAME=taigu1build SET SVN_USERPWD=123456 SET SVNEXE=svn.exe
if %SvnUpdateType% == None GOTO END_SVN_UDPATE if %SvnUpdateType% == UpdateAndRevert GOTO SVN_UPDATE_AND_REVERT if %SvnUpdateType% == UpdateNoRevert GOTO SVN_UPDATE_AND_NOTREVERT :SVN_UPDATE_AND_REVERT cd %PROJ_PATH% CALL %SVNEXE% cleanup --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% CALL %SVNEXE% revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R . CALL %SVNEXE% update --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% if %SvnUpdateType% == UpdateAndRevert GOTO END_SVN_UDPATE :SVN_UPDATE_AND_NOTREVERT cd %PROJ_PATH% CALL %SVNEXE% cleanup --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% CALL %SVNEXE% update --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% echo "Update Done. `date`" :END_SVN_UDPATE
svn revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R %PROJ_PATH%\ProjectSettings
SET HOTFIX_LINKING=%PROJ_PATH%\Assets\hotfix SET HOTFIX_PROJ=%PROJ_PATH%\hotfix\hotfix\iLScript if %UseHotFix% == true ( RD /S /Q %HOTFIX_LINKING% GOTO END_LINK_HOTFIX ) if NOT exist %HOTFIX_LINKING% GOTO LINK_HOTFIX :LINK_HOTFIX REM RD /S /Q %HOTFIX_LINKING% MKLINK /J %HOTFIX_LINKING% %HOTFIX_PROJ% :END_LINK_HOTFIX
SETLOCAL enabledelayedexpansion
REM 重新导出as工程，则revert打包工程 if %OnlyBuildProject% == true GOTO EXPORT_AS_SUCCESS
if %Platform% == Android ECHO GOTO PLATFORM_ANDROID_AS_REVERT if %Platform% == WEBGL ECHO GOTO PLATFORM_WEBGL_PROJ_REVERT :PLATFORM_ANDROID_AS_REVERT if %BuildPkgType% == APKAndAAB GOTO REVERT_ASPROJ_APK if %BuildPkgType% == APK GOTO REVERT_ASPROJ_APK if %BuildPkgType% == AAB GOTO REVERT_ASPROJ_AAB :REVERT_ASPROJ_APK SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH=!PROJ_PATH!\AndroidSDK\BuildModelProject svn revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw if %BuildPkgType% == APK GOTO END_REVERT_ASPROJ :REVERT_ASPROJ_AAB SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH=!PROJ_PATH!\AndroidSDK\BuildModelProject svn revert --username=%SVN_USERNAME% --password=%SVN_USERPWD% -R !ANDROID_PROJECT_PATH!\tgsw_google :PLATFORM_WEBGL_PROJ_REVERT ECHO WEBGL PROJ REVERT ... :END_REVERT_ASPROJ ENDLOCAL

org.jenkinsci.plugins.unity3d.Unity3dBui.argLine: -projectPath ${PRO_NAME}/shengwang -batchMode -disable-assembly-updater -executeMethod Jenkins.JenkinsBuild.BuildMain -quit -batchmode -logFile ${WORKSPACE}/${PRO_NAME}/shengwang/BuildLog/build_android.log -buildTarget ${Platform} ABNameWithHash ${ABNameWithHash} StripLvl ${StripLvl} StripEngineCode ${StripEngineCode} UseIL2CPP ${UseIL2CPP} AssetLoadType ${AssetLoadType} BuildPatch ${BuildPatch} AbdetailVer ${AbdetailVer} Platform ${Platform} BuildRes ${BuildRes} ResVer ${ResVer} IsDebug ${IsDebug} BuildPkgType ${BuildPkgType} IsBuildPkg ${IsBuildPkg} VersionName ${VersionName} VersionCode ${VersionCode} PkgType ${PkgType} OutputPath ${OutputPath} RemoveManifest ${RemoveManifest} BuildMode ${BuildMode}

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
SETLOCAL enabledelayedexpansion
SET SVN_USERNAME=taigu1build SET SVN_USERPWD=123456 REM Unity执行完后处理 SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang SET ZIP_EXE=C:\ZipTool\7z.exe SET RELEASE_PATCH_DIR=%WORKSPACE%\www\%PRO_NAME%\patch SET RELEASE_VER_DIR=%WORKSPACE%\www\%PRO_NAME%\%VersionName%\
CD %PROJ_PATH% if %IsBuildPkg% == false GOTO BUILD_PKG_END if %IsBuildPkg% == true GOTO BUILD_PKG_BEGIN :BUILD_PKG_BEGIN MKDIR !RELEASE_VER_DIR! SET NEW_EXE_NAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Identify%_%PkgType%_%VersionName%_d%IsDebug%_v%UseHotFix%.zip if %IsDebug% == false GOTO BUILD_RELEASE if %IsDebug% == true GOTO BUILD_DEBUG
:BUILD_RELEASE CD %PROJ_PATH%\qq_release !ZIP_EXE! a !NEW_EXE_NAME! -mx0 MonoBleedingEdge %Identify%_Data %Identify%.exe UnityCrashHandler32.exe UnityPlayer.dll config.ini ECHO F|XCOPY /Y !NEW_EXE_NAME! !RELEASE_VER_DIR! GOTO BUILD_PKG_END
:BUILD_DEBUG CD %PROJ_PATH%\qq_debug !ZIP_EXE! a !NEW_EXE_NAME! -mx0 MonoBleedingEdge %Identify%_Data %Identify%.exe UnityCrashHandler32.exe UnityPlayer.dll config.ini ECHO F|XCOPY /Y !NEW_EXE_NAME! !RELEASE_VER_DIR! GOTO BUILD_PKG_END
:BUILD_PKG_END if %BuildPatch% == true GOTO END_BUILD_PATCH if NOT %BuildPatch% == true GOTO END_BUILD_PATCH :BUILD_PATCH MKDIR !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR! SET DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE=%PROJ_PATH%\PatchBuild SET PATCH_NAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Identify%_windows_%ResVer%.zip ECHO ZIP_EXE: !ZIP_EXE! ECHO RELEASE_PATCH_DIR: !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR! ECHO DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE: !DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE! ECHO PATCH_NAME: !PATCH_NAME!
CD !DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE! !ZIP_EXE! a !PATCH_NAME! -mx0 VersionInfo.txt Res UpdateInfo.txt ECHO F|XCOPY /Y *.zip !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR! :END_BUILD_PATCH ENDLOCAL

org.jenkinsci.plugins.unity3d.Unity3dBui.argLine: -projectPath ${PRO_NAME}/shengwang -batchMode -disable-assembly-updater -executeMethod Jenkins.JenkinsBuild.BuildMain -quit -batchmode -logFile ${WORKSPACE}/${PRO_NAME}/shengwang/BuildLog/build_android.log -buildTarget ${Platform} Platform ${Platform} BuildResPkg ${BuildResPkg} PkgFileName ${BUILD_NUMBER}_${Identify}_${ResVer}.kg AbdetailVer ${AbdetailVer} ResVer ${ResVer}

hudson.tasks.BatchFile.command:
SETLOCAL enabledelayedexpansion SET ZIP_EXE=C:\ZipTool\7z.exe SET PROJ_PATH=%WORKSPACE%\%PRO_NAME%\shengwang
SET RELEASE_PATCH_DIR=%WORKSPACE%\www\%PRO_NAME%\patch SET DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE=%PROJ_PATH%\PkgBuild MKDIR !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR!
CD !DIR_SAVE_PATCHFILE!
SET RELEASE_PATCH_DIR_PKG=%WORKSPACE%\www\%PRO_NAME%\PKGS SET PKGNAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Identify%_%ResVer%.kg SET PKGINFONAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Identify%_%ResVer%.info REN pkg.kg %PKGNAME% REN pkg.info %PKGINFONAME% REM ECHO F|XCOPY /Y %PKGNAME% !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR_PKG! REM ECHO F|XCOPY /Y %PKGINFONAME% !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR_PKG!
ECHO %PKGINFONAME%>VersionPkgInfo.txt SET PATCH_NAME=%BUILD_NUMBER%_%Identify%_windows_%ResVer%.zip !ZIP_EXE! a !PATCH_NAME! -mx0 %PKGNAME% %PKGINFONAME% VersionPkgInfo.txt ECHO F|XCOPY /Y *.zip !RELEASE_PATCH_DIR!
ENDLOCAL
